topic: Eigenvalues, Eigenvectors, and the Power Iteration

entry_point.discipline_context: Modal reasoning in a matrix model of mechanical vibration motivates finding an important direction without solving every mode explicitly.
entry_point.rationale: The learner knows matrices and basic Python but not iterative eigensolvers.
entry_point.analogy_boundary: The vibration language motivates interpretation; definitions and computations are mathematical statements.

conditional_item_decisions.rationale: The characteristic equation is explicitly in scope.
The requested non-symmetric scope limitation is taught.
The corrected positive-integer max_iterations validation is required.
The supplied worked matrix result is requested.

chapter_sequence.title: Eigenpairs as special matrix directions
chapter_sequence.purpose: Define eigenpairs, introduce the characteristic equation, and distinguish magnitude dominance.

chapter_sequence.title: Symmetric matrices and modal components
chapter_sequence.purpose: Build the orthonormal eigenbasis and derive dominant-component selection.

chapter_sequence.title: Power iteration and convergence behaviour
chapter_sequence.purpose: State the normalized iteration, convergence assumptions, rate, and failure cases.

chapter_sequence.title: Estimates, residuals, and a NumPy implementation
chapter_sequence.purpose: Connect diagnostics to an executable implementation and the worked matrix result.

chapter_sequence.title: Exercises and worked solutions
chapter_sequence.purpose: Assess the taught concepts, one iteration step, and implementation diagnostics.

implementation_strategy: Executable NumPy iteration with floating conversion, shape and input validation, positive-integer iteration validation, breakdown check, residual stop, maximum-iteration fallback, and four-value return.
assessment_strategy: Exactly three final worked exercises: one concept check, one power-iteration hand calculation, and one code diagnostic.

exercise_plan.learning_objective: Identify the target, convergence assumptions, failure cases, and non-symmetric scope limitation.
Compute one normalized power-iteration step, the Rayleigh quotient, and residual diagnostics as one chain.
exercise_plan.discipline_context: Carry out a two-coordinate modal calculation.

exercise_plan.learning_objective: Diagnose missing validation, breakdown handling, residual stopping, and return semantics.
